speaker: rook
situation: Pip is sorting vegetables in the kitchen.
line: Stew's at the back. Take the bigger bowl, you need it more than I do.
label: kind

speaker: pip
situation: Rook has been scrubbing the stove for an hour.
line: That stew was really good tonight, Nate. You made my whole day better.
label: kind

speaker: tuk
situation: Pip just finished her first day with the hunting party.
line: You kept up. Good legs. Tuk will bring you next time.
label: kind

speaker: moth
situation: Rook skipped lunch to finish cooking for the others.
line: I saved you a plate, I think it's still warm. Probably.
label: kind

speaker: pip
situation: Moth is shaking after the alarm sounded.
line: Hey, breathe. It's over now. I'm right here, okay?
label: comfort

speaker: rook
situation: Pip is crying over Hana's empty chair.
line: Sit. It stays empty. That's all right. Eat something.
label: comfort

speaker: ash
situation: Moth is staring at her sleeve covered in blood.
line: You did the work. He is alive. That is enough. Wash your hands.
label: comfort

speaker: lux
situation: Rook asks whether the stew is salty enough.
line: Salty enough to preserve a corpse, naturally. Perhaps next time, taste it.
label: slight

speaker: ash
situation: Moth is giving her research report in the dining room.
line: Is that all? I have heard longer reports from privates.
label: slight

speaker: rook
situation: Lux offers to help in the kitchen.
line: You hold a ladle like a candlestick. Go and paint something.
label: slight

speaker: lux
situation: Tuk drags a carcass across the common room floor.
line: You are a wonder, truly. Even the flies leave a room faster than you.
label: insult

speaker: ash
situation: Lux has called the guard rota unfair again.
line: You are a waste of rations and you know it. Sit down before I make you.
label: insult

speaker: rook
situation: Moth spilled soup across the pantry floor.
line: Idiot. You can't carry a bowl, you can't cook, and you can't even apologise properly.
label: insult

speaker: moth
situation: The two are alone in the lab at night.
line: Pip, I haven't slept in days. I think I hear Hana in the vents.
label: confide

speaker: ash
situation: The two are on watch at night.
line: I filled a mass grave once. I do not talk about it. Now you know.
label: confide

speaker: lux
situation: Moth is cleaning brushes at dusk.
line: I was never a courtier by choice, Ines. They took my sister to pay the debt.
label: confide

speaker: pip
situation: Tuk is sharpening her knife by the fire.
line: Did you know Lux cries when he thinks nobody's listening? I heard him last night.
label: gossip

speaker: moth
situation: Lux and Moth are at the lab bench.
line: Nate told me Ash has not slept since Hana died. He just sits on the wall, apparently.
label: gossip

speaker: tuk
situation: Ash asks what people are saying.
line: The kitchen says Moth took silver from the safe. Rook told Pip, Pip told Tuk.
label: gossip

speaker: ash
situation: Pip asks how the raid went.
line: Eleven hostiles. Four hundred meters. Six dropped by me. I do not miss.
label: boast

speaker: tuk
situation: The party is back from a long hunt.
line: Tuk dragged a muffalo home alone. Five men could not have done it.
label: boast

speaker: lux
situation: Lux is alone in the common room, painting.
line: I once painted a portrait that was hung in the Grand Orbital Hall. Naturally.
label: boast

speaker: lux
situation: Lux has been living on the floor for a week.
line: This colony has no chairs, no wine and no decency. One adapts, but one resents.
label: complain

speaker: moth
situation: The lab has been cold for three days.
line: The bench is freezing, the lamp flickers, and I've lost feeling in two fingers.
label: complain

speaker: rook
situation: Rook has been carrying crates all morning.
line: Back's killing me. Nobody lifts a finger around here. Not one of you.
label: complain

speaker: ash
situation: Ash wants to know the status of the medicine.
line: Medicine count is eleven. Wall repairs begin at six.
label: none

speaker: rook
situation: Pip is waiting by the stove.
line: Stew's in twenty minutes. Table by the window.
label: none

speaker: pip
situation: Tuk is heading out of the gate.
line: Are you hunting north or east today?
label: none

speaker: moth
situation: Lux is walking past the lab.
line: The culture should resolve by noon. I'll let you know.
label: none

speaker: tuk
situation: Ash asks where the herd is.
line: Muffalo are by the east ridge. About forty. Moving slow.
label: none
